response.sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 2400 AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, a.account_id ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average balance is taken over the same filtered transactions (amount > 2400, type PRIJEM or VYDAJ), not over all of each account's transactions.
trans.amount is stored unsigned, so direction comes only from trans.type, as the verified note states. VYBER rows are excluded because the request leaves other types out.

The request does not say how to break ties at the 10th position. I added account_id ASC as a deterministic tiebreak, so rows tied on avg_balance at the cutoff may be chosen differently under another rule.
frequency is a single value per account in the account table, so grouping by it does not split any account's group.
